scope: Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Taiwan Traditional and Hong Kong Traditional. Generic zh remains the Simplified mirror. Only listed changes are covered; existing historical review files remain unchanged.
provenancePolicy: Retain every existing machine flag and mark new translations as machine drafts. No full-catalog or native fluency certification.
hashFormat: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 runtime message string (Chrome named placeholders preserved); fragment hashes normalize CRLF to LF. The final changes below supersede original proposals.

zaif-orders.evidence: Japanese exchange usage: 買い注文, 売り注文, 数量, 未約定数量. Supports terminology only; Zaif matching and execution guarantees are not Counterparty rules.

uniswap-ja.evidence: swap.settings.routingPreference.option.default.tooltip uses 価格インパクト; onboarding/backup strings use recovery-phrase terminology. Uniswap execution/revert promises are deliberately not imported.

uniswap-en.evidence: Matching pinned English source establishes that routing tooltip is estimated price impact. The separate swap.priceImpact currently means Price difference, so key names alone are not evidence.

launchpad-ja.evidence: Shipped Price impact = 価格インパクト, Buy = 買い, Sell = 売り, Filled = 約定済み. Market = 成行 is an order-type context and is not copied to the extension’s market navigation.

existing-review.evidence: Earlier bounded review already selected 価格インパクト for both pool-slippage setting descriptions.

extension-dispenser.evidence: Both common_open uses are an open dispenser state/tab; no open-window action uses were found.

core-dispenser.evidence: Dispenser status 0/1 is open; status 10 is closed. No dispenser accounting or status value changes are proposed.

extension-order.evidence: Give/get labels accompany exact quantities and asset identifiers; remaining amounts use the corresponding asset’s divisibility.

core-order.evidence: Order state keeps give_remaining/get_remaining separately; matches reduce the residuals, and cancellation recredits eligible give_remaining. These labels describe unfilled terms, not spendable balance.

extension-balance.evidence: pendingIncoming is explicitly documented as unconfirmed incoming display units, never included in spendable balance; $1 is a spacer and $2 is the formatted amount.

core-mpma.evidence: Compose validation rejects a repeated destination for the same asset, while a destination may appear across different assets.

extension-fairminter.evidence: Field uses quantity_by_price_normalized; the nearby price-per-unit field uses price_normalized.

core-fairminter.evidence: quantity_by_price is a positive integer quantity per priced lot.

core-verbose.evidence: Unit price derives from price / quantity_by_price; lot quantity normalizes against the issued asset.

extension-market.evidence: Error is attached to fetching more pool rows.

extension-recovery.evidence: Same mnemonic secret is called a recovery phrase in existing adjacent headings. Import still supports existing BIP39 and Counterwallet mnemonic paths; private-key import/removal remains distinct.

extension-unconfirmed.evidence: allowUnconfirmedTxs is the actual toggle passed into UTXO selection and allow_unconfirmed_inputs; proposal changes description only.

balance_pending_dividend.description: Compact pending label for a dividend distribution event or its fee, not staking yield.

decisions: Recovery Phrase names the word list returned by getUnencryptedMnemonic; the optional BIP39 passphrase is different. Routes and decryption are unchanged.
Core order.py records tx.fee as fee_provided and uses it for BTC-order matching. The setting is not the fee of the subsequent BTCPay transaction.
Dispenser give_quantity is per lot. Core dispense.py can fulfill multiple paid lots in one transaction.

Order events are historical snapshots, not live order state. Use only the transaction’s own opening and matching ORDER_UPDATE records, and their explicit expire_index; mempool decode status is not current mined state.

Core MPMA compose.unpack projects only send_info[0] for each asset. Complete events or explicit legacy tuples are required for totals; per-asset raw amounts are summed exactly and equal-per-address is stated only when true.
Trezor INIT_FAILED describes TrezorConnect.init(), so final wording specifies initializing the connection, not resetting the device.
Keep local failure facts until UI render. Known codes translate; unknown vendor/API evidence remains raw. Language changes do not initiate network/device operations.
Browser language remains automatic by default; fiat is independent and defaults to USD. Canonical amount drafts and the pinned SDK contract are unchanged.

Integrate PR403 search/pagination and PR404 version0.11.2 without reverting request ownership, bounded retries, offsets, incomplete-search state or partial rows. Translate newly introduced statuses and retain unknown error evidence. Managed assets does not promise that an asset’s locked issuance can issue more supply.
limitations: AI contextual and layout review is not native-speaker certification.
Additional Launchpad languages remain deferred for a subsequent pass.
Raw unknown API/device diagnostics and background marketplace bundle-proof wording may remain English.
Core verbose historical asset metadata can reflect a later asset reset; this pass does not add historical divisibility lookups.
No real hardware signing, real-value transactions, Chrome Web Store submission, or extension release is performed by this follow-up.
